prompt: Convert 1-hexanol to hexanoic acid in one step with Jones reagent. Draw the acid.

traps.note: Jones is strong + aqueous → goes to COOH. For aldehyde, use PCC.

explanation: Aqueous CrO3/H2SO4 oxidizes 1° alcohols all the way to carboxylic acids. The intermediate aldehyde hydrates and gets re-oxidized.
